in_hebrew.name: עֶתֶרֶם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word עָתוֹר (עָתוּר), meaning to wander or be a stranger, comes the name עֶתֶרֶם (Etrem), which means 'exile' or 'stranger'. This name can be used to describe someone who is an outsider or someone who is in exile.

in_greek.name: Έτρεμος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Έτρεμος (Etrem) is derived from the Greek word έτροπος (etropos), which means 'turned away' or 'stranger'. This name was given to someone who was a foreigner or an outsider, or to someone who had turned away from their previous life or beliefs.

in_latin.name: Etremus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Etremus is derived from the Latin word 'etrusco', which refers to the ancient Etruscan civilization. The name Etremus can be used to describe someone who is a foreigner or an outsider, or it can be used as a reference to the Etruscan culture.
